name: multi-tenant-isolation-check
cost_provenance: measured 2026-09-30 on the dev workstation (win32, under concurrent cargo load), static mode; see docs/planning/project-checks-review-2026-09.md
question: Is the tenant-scoped repository layer still the sole query path (DEC-FBR-03)? Probe A: no raw SQL outside the repository crate -- sqlx query!/query()/raw_sql/string-SQL execute/fetch, pool fetches, sqlx re-exports; a handler transaction may only be handed to repository *_in_executor methods, committed or rolled back. Probe B: every public repository fn (generics included) takes &TenantScope/&ProjectScope first, or is in allowlist.toml with a rationale that still names a real fn.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail (file:line). Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 environment error. A missing target is a FAIL, never a vacuous PASS.

consumer_scope: P0+ all crates (every Stage 1+ worker; CI gate)
fallback: Read .claude/project-oracles/multi-tenant-isolation-check/README.md: it lists each probe as rewritten on 2026-09-30 and what to check by hand; the `question` above is the one-paragraph form.

provenance.rationale: DEC-FBR-03 declares raw SQL outside repository layer a security incident. Type system (TenantScope/ProjectScope newtypes) is leg 1; this oracle is leg 2 (runtime/AST); clippy + cargo-deny is leg 3.
